title: opendubs.capture/1: one mapping drive
description: The manifest of one attended mapping drive of one floor, written as captures/<yyyymmdd>-<building>-<floor>[-n]/capture.yaml. It names everything needed to rebuild the map offline later: the robot and code that recorded it, the sensors and their calibration, where the drive started, the saved map and the recording, each large file by host path and sha256.

key.description: The building's directory in this repo.

fms.description: UW Facilities building number, as on the drawings.

floor.description: The FMS floor code, as the drawings spell it: 0G, 01..07, B1, M2..M5.

clock.description: Whether the robot's clock was synchronized. The Thor has no clock battery: until NTP syncs, bag stamps are wrong, and 'corrected_offset_s' says by how much if it was found later.

description_sha256.description: sha256 of the URDF robot_state_publisher was running: the sensor extrinsics.

lift_m.description: Scissor-lift height during the drive, if it was fixed.

code.description: What recorded it: the opendubs commit deployed on the robot, and the mapping tool's own version.

branch.description: Set when the robot ran an unmerged branch (lane rule 5).

slam.description: The SLAM that built the live map, e.g. slam_toolbox on /scan.

operator.description: Who drove: initials or a team handle, enough to ask them about the drive.

sensors.description: Every sensor recorded, with where its calibration came from.

model.description: e.g. RPLIDAR A1, goBILDA Pinpoint, Orbbec Femto Bolt.

calibration.description: Where its intrinsics and extrinsics came from: a file by path and sha256, or 'urdf' (robot.description_sha256), or 'factory'.

start.description: Where the drive started, so the map can be seeded against the plan.

landmark.description: In words a person can find again: 'centre of the elevator lobby, facing the doors'.

room.description: FMS room number nearest the start, if known.

pose_building.description: The start pose in the building frame, if it was known at the time. Usually filled later by a registration.

map.description: The map saved at the end of the drive. Small files are committed beside the manifest; the pose graph is referenced.

name.description: As saved on the robot, e.g. gates_f2-20261110.

files.description: Every split of the bag (2 GB each) and its metadata.yaml.

color.description: Whether the bag holds colour frames (pictures of people): left out at record time (--no-color), still present, blurred, or deleted afterwards.

notes.description: Anything the next person needs: doors that were closed, a floor area skipped, SLAM losing track.

file.description: A file by where it lives and its content hash. 'path' is relative to this capture directory when committed here; otherwise 'host' names the machine (opendubs2, the team Drive) and 'path' is absolute there.
